title: docs(ui): retire the CI/CD guide page and repoint its readers at the root workflows
body:
Fixes #26944

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:删除 `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`(3,243 行,描述 objectui 已删除的 28 个 workflow)及其导航条目;`deployment.md` 与根 `CONTRIBUTING.md` 的 UI 节改为指向根 `.github/workflows/`;读这一页的测试、台账行与注释指针逐一改指向或随页删除。
- 为什么改:这一页的作业名、触发条件和必需检查在 monorepo 下全部不成立,贡献者照它理解 `ui/` 的 PR 检查会得到错误答案;维护者选定 F14 走「整页退役」(shape A)。
- 风险与回滚:只动文档、测试与注释,不动产品代码、不动 `.github/**`;变更行数 4,023 主要来自删页,超过 3,000 行人合线。回滚即整 PR revert。
- 先看:`ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`(台账删 11 行)、`ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`(删两条清单项、两个下限 3→2)、`ui/scripts/__tests__/merge-queue-reporting.test.ts`(整文件删除,理由见下)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n ci-cd-pipeline` 只剩 `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md` 的两行历史;`node ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` 退出 0。
- 需要你做的:变更行数超 3,000,需要你合并或入队(也可由授权批准后席位落地)。

## What changes

Shape A, as the seat picked it on the claim: the page is retired, not rewritten.

- **Deleted** `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` and its `ui/content/docs/guide/meta.json` entry.
- **Pointers.** `ui/content/docs/guide/deployment.md`'s Next Steps link now points at the root `.github/workflows/` on GitHub. The root `CONTRIBUTING.md` UI Workspace section (where #27001 folded `ui/CONTRIBUTING.md`) gains a short `### UI CI` subsection: GitHub runs only the root workflows, and `ci.yml`'s `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` and `Build & E2E UI` jobs check a `ui/` change. No CI doc was written.
- **Readers.** 31 files named `ci-cd-pipeline` on `origin/main` `cb8988ee1`. Each one, classified:

| File | Class | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | the page | deleted |
| `ui/content/docs/guide/meta.json` | reader (nav) | entry dropped |
| `ui/content/docs/guide/deployment.md` | reader (link) | repointed to the root workflows |
| `check-control-bytes.test.ts`, `check-doc-fence-languages.test.ts`, `check-docs-route-eager-closure.test.ts` | pin, path used as a glob PROBE (does a docs-only change under `ui/` start Lint UI?) | **retargeted** to the live `content/docs/guide/deployment.md`; the pin still guards the `ui` filter globs |
| `check-doc-example-shared-reader.test.ts`, `check-handler-key-read-sites.test.ts`, `check-doc-json-fences.test.ts` | pin, page half of a mixed `it` | page half **removed**; the `package.json` / root `ci.yml` halves stay |
| `check-doc-example-types.test.ts`, `check-doc-expression-carriage.test.ts`, `check-doc-snippet-emitted-census.test.ts`, `check-skill-eval-tokens.test.ts`, `check-skill-examples.test.ts` | pin asserting the page's content | `it` **removed** with the page, a one-line retirement note left in place |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.test.ts` | two pins asserting the page's content | both `it`s **removed**; the classifier pin stays |
| `check-required-check-set.test.ts` | the page as one of the `REPAIRED` carriers | page **dropped** from `REPAIRED`; `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` stays and is still asserted |
| `lint-workflow.test.ts` | the page as one of three `SURFACES` | page surface **removed** with its markdown-section helper; the root `lint-ui` job and `check-lint-coverage.mjs` surfaces stay |
| `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` | its last `describe` asserted the page's `## Merge Queue` section | **whole file removed**, see Acceptance notes |
| `doc-version-claims.test.ts` | two `KNOWN_CLAIMS` entries on the page, plus header history | entries **removed** (the ratchet's stale-entry test requires it); two vacuity floors 3 → 2; history re-worded |
| `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` | ledger rows | three `notRead` rows retargeted with their probes; ten rows **removed** because `--audit` reports those tests as no longer candidates; the `merge-queue-reporting` row removed with its file |
| `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` | vacuity floors fed by the removed rows | 35 → 27 and 4 → 3, each with its reason |
| `backend.env`, `saved-view-filter.spec.ts`, `reserved-auth-features.test.ts`, `ci-setup-pnpm-wiring.test.ts`, `coverage-shard-reporter-readability.test.ts`, `check-lockfile-integrity.mjs`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs`, `check-required-check-set.mjs`, `cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs`, `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` | comment pointer | re-worded to name the page or its pin test as retired (#26058 deleted the pin test, this PR the page) |
| `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md` | history | untouched |

Comment pointers to `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` (seven, in `check-governed-queue-guard.test.ts`, `check-shell-escape-residue.test.ts`, `check-skill-examples.test.ts`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`, `select-affected-tests.mjs`, `select-type-check-scope.mjs`) now say it is retired, so none points at a live file that is not there.

No `.github/**`, `.claude/**` or product code is touched. No published file changes: the one file under a public package, `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/reserved-auth-features.test.ts`, is excluded from that package's emitting `tsc` program (`tsc --listFilesOnly`: 0 hits for it, control `src/index` 1 hit), so this carries `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

Head `11fce5c7e`.

- The 24 touched or affected suites, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `Test Files 24 passed (24)`, `Tests 842 passed (842)`, VERDICT command-exit 0 (at `7b575a165`; the last commit rewraps two comments, and those two files re-ran green: 2/2, 14/14).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (the card's acceptance command): `173 passed | 2 failed | 2 skipped` of 177 files. Neither failure is in a touched file, and both are local build state, not this diff:
  - `date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` failed with "ran no case at all". It passed after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/formula...' build` (re-run: 1 of 2 files passed).
  - `unit-registry-absence-collision.test.ts` failed because 30 workspace modules could not be imported (`Failed to resolve entry for package "@objectstack/client"`, an unbuilt dist). It is NOT MEASURED locally; CI builds the closure.
- `node ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit`: exit 0. Output: `96 candidate test files, all adjudicated; 70 declared entries, all present.`

## Acceptance notes

- **`merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` was deleted as a whole.** After #25712, its only assertions were the four in `ci-cd-pipeline.md does not keep its own copy of the subscriber list`. Each one read the page's `## Merge Queue` section, or (`keeps the dated exemption honest`) a list that exists only to exempt one paragraph of that page. Its `MUST_SUBSCRIBE_MERGE_GROUP` map names objectui's workflows, which run nowhere, and no other assertion reads it. With the page gone, the file had nothing live to pin, and an empty suite fails vitest. The root gates its header names (`check:required-contexts`, `check:workflow-status-functions`) still carry both #3523 holes.
- **The floors were lowered, not removed.** `doc-version-claims` keeps `>= 2` workflow-anchored lines (`building-crud-app.md`, `quick-start.md`). `markdown-test-inputs` keeps `>= 27` scripts candidates and `>= 3` `AGENTS.md` readers. Each new number is the measured count after the page left, recorded beside the floor.
- **Ledger rows removed, not set to `reads: []`.** `--audit` fails on a ledger row whose test is no longer a scanner candidate (`stale-test`). The ten tests named the page as their only candidate literal, so their rows had to go. `check-doc-json-fences` and `check-doc-snippet-emitted-census` still walk markdown through imported helpers. The ledger's header says that route is invisible to the scanner.
- **Size.** 4,023 changed lines (+138 / −3,886), almost all of it the page deletion. That is over the 3,000-line human-merge threshold, so this lands by the maintainer's merge or enqueue.
